bodyHtml:
Aquasky Getting ACS Sanitary Conformity certified (Attestation de Conformité Sanitaire in French)

Aquasky has proved our products are high quality by complying with the ACS certification.

ACS is the French health certification bodies, chiefly based on AFNOR (Association Francaise de Normalisation) announced standards for Plumbing products testing. Any device or accessory which is in contact with drinking water must be ACS certifiied in France.
